text:
deploy-bot: Automated rollback trigger: release v3.6.0 -> p95 error rate = 3.4x baseline over last 5m. Suggested action: AUTO_ROLLBACK. Suppressed: change-window=customer-sensitive, grace-period=10m. See /runbooks/rollback.

suresh: saw this. which customer is in the sensitive window? can we delay auto-rollback for 10m while we confirm? @maria fyi

maria: it's the Payments EU batch run for @BigFin. They explicitly asked for no interruption between 03:00-04:30 UTC. currently at 03:12. we need manual approval to override deploy-bot suppression or proceed with a manual rollback + customer comms.

amy: what's the root metric? is it model timeouts or 5xx from infra? quick summary plz.

deploy-bot: Metric details: model-serving p95 latency spike + request timeouts from kv-cache backend. Error breakdown: 62% model timeouts, 28% backend 5xx, 10% client cancels. Canary traffic slice (5%) shows same trend. Canary started 03:00.

suresh: ok—my read: service-level is degrading. Because this is a customer-sensitive window, I propose: stage a manual rollback to v3.5.2 on non-critical shards now, hold EU payments shard for 5m while ops drafts comms, then full rollback if no mitigation.

maria: agree. ops should prepare rollback commands and release notes update. amy, can you grab logs for the kv-cache rolling restarts? put them in the incident doc.

amy: on it. collecting logs and will paste the key snippets in a sec.

ops-bot: Prepared rollback run: redwoodctl rollout undo --service inference --to-version v3.5.2 --selector=region:global --grace=30s

suresh: don't run global yet. we want a 2-stage exec: 1) non-payment regions (usw/usw2) 2) EU payments shard after 5m hold. I'll execute stage 1. ops-bot, split command pls.

ops-bot: Command for stage 1 (non-eu):
```
redwoodctl rollout undo --service inference --to-version v3.5.2 --selector='region in (usw,usw2)' --force --reason 'auto-triggered p95 spike'
```

suresh: executing stage 1 now.

suresh: stage 1 done. traffic back to v3.5.2 for usw/usw2. latency down in those regions, p95 trending back toward baseline.

maria: drafting customer note for BigFin. short and factual: what we changed, why, ETA for EU shard, link to incident doc. ping me when ready and I'll send through the account channel.

amy: logs attached in incident doc: kv-cache OOM churn during canary. PR 4821 fixes cache sizing but needs canary validation. suggest we pin v3.5.2 while we test the fix in staging.

suresh: good. let's pin target version for BigFin to v3.5.2 and schedule a dedicated canary for PR4821 in staging. manual approval required before EU shard move.

deploy-bot: Note: AUTO_ROLLBACK suppression lifted for EU payments shard due to manual override by @suresh at 1728510180.

maria: customer note ready. copying here for review:
"We detected an elevated error rate affecting a small fraction of requests during your scheduled batch run. We reverted the inference service to the previous stable version (v3.5.2) in non-EU regions and are holding changes for the EU payments shard while we validate a fix. We will follow up with a detailed postmortem and any required mitigation steps."

amy: lgtm. add link to incident doc and PR4821.

maria: sending to account team now. @suresh please proceed with EU shard rollback after you get the green from account and confirm customer readiness.

suresh: will wait for explicit account ack. setting reminder for 03:20 to reassess. thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Runbook excerpt: when manual-override during change-window -> confirm business owner, prepare staged rollback command, update release-notes & accounts, execute non-customer-critical regions first, then customer shard after ack. Logging: annotate rollback with uid and reason.

maria: adding rollback annotation: rollback_uid=rb-1728509999-1, reason='p95 spike, manual override for customer-window'

suresh: final note: pin v3.5.2 on the EU payments pool and create a follow-up ticket to validate PR4821 in staging, target fix & canary before next change window. closing thread for now unless new alerts crop up.

amy: filing ticket: INF-7349 (validate PR4821 in staging + canary). tagging infra and eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: monitoring resumed; will post if metrics cross thresholds again.
